tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Post ground. Daylight = white for everyday advisory posts; Navy = deep navy for premium, seasonal and announcement posts.

tokens.name: surface-mist
tokens.usage: The cool wash behind hero imagery and the fade at the top of the canvas. Replaces the ad-hoc light-blue gradients.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Solid navy panels: fact chips, closing slide, footer band on dark posts.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, grid dividers, the rule under a slide number. Decorative only, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, pointers, captions. 15.6:1 on surface, 13.7:1 on surface-mist (both themes pass AA).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: handle, website, swipe cue, source lines. 6.9:1 on surface, 6.1:1 on surface-mist (daylight); 7.7:1 / 6.6:1 (navy).

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: The heavy-caps keyword word (BUSINESS, LAUNCH, STRONGER). 11.1:1 on surface, 9.8:1 on surface-mist.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Marina Blue. Secondary emphasis word (Business, Documents) and link-style text. 5.3:1 on surface, 4.6:1 on surface-mist; 6.9:1 on navy surface.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Dune Gold. The one gold word per post. Daylight: 3.8:1 on white, so DISPLAY SIZES ONLY (48px+ on the 1080 canvas). Navy: 9.0:1, any size. The old ochre (#d9a441) was 2.3:1 on white and is retired.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold at text sizes (labels, small highlights) on surface and surface-mist. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: gold-leaf
tokens.usage: Decorative fills only: rules, the pointer triangle, blocks on navy. Never text on a light ground.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Fill of the key tag (BUSINESS SETUP, You need in Dubai). Flips to gold on Navy so the tag doesn't disappear into the ground.

tokens.name: on-tag
tokens.usage: Text on a tag fill. 11.1:1 daylight, 9.0:1 navy.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on surface-deep panels. 13.7:1+.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Warning marks only: the X on a mistake, a deadline. Always paired with a word; never decorative (no petals, no hearts). 5.4:1 on white.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Geeza Pro", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Post headlines
groups.note: Sizes are pixels on the 1080 x 1350 post canvas. One family, two voices: light italic for the lead-in, heavy caps for the keyword.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Listicle and count posts only. One per post.

styles.name: keyword
styles.usage: The one word the post is about. Uppercase, 1 to 2 words, color headline or gold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Title-case headline when the phrase is too long for keyword caps.

styles.name: lead-in
styles.usage: The soft half of the headline, above or below the keyword. Always italic 300, never bold.

groups.name: Post text
groups.note: Nothing on the canvas is smaller than caption (24px). At feed size that is ~9pt, the practical floor on a phone.

styles.name: pointer
styles.usage: The supporting line with the gold triangle marker. Max 2 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Improper liquidation can freeze your accounts for years.
styles.usage: Carousel slide copy. Max 40 words per slide.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Footer band: website and swipe cue, ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit on the 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between lead-in and keyword.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Column gutter; tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between headline stack and tag or pointer.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between headline block and body; tag inner horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between content zones.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Outer safe margin on all four sides. Covers the ~34px side crop of the 3:4 profile-grid thumbnail.

tokens.name: header-band
tokens.usage: Top band holding the logo. Top-right of this band stays EMPTY: Instagram's carousel icon sits there.

tokens.name: footer-band
tokens.usage: Bottom band: website left, swipe cue right.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Key tag and fact chip. Matches the current BUSINESS SETUP tag.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Image panels and navy fact panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Swipe cue and step dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The only shadow: under a hero cut-out subject or a floating tag. Never on text.
